segments.text: The leader of the Longinus Dreizehn Orden. Originally a high-ranking official in Germany, regarded as highly dangerous due to his seemingly boundless talent in all fields. Later, he bowed out of the public eye through the guise of a staged assassination, and formed the Obsidian Round Table alongside Mercurius.

Their subordinate members acted behind the scenes of WW2 and kept on destroying friend and foe alike. His acts of destruction reached their climax during the fall of Berlin. However, he and his three direct subordinates disappeared shortly afterwards, leaving their current whereabouts a mystery.
"You would do well not to disappoint me."
From Dies irae's Kickstarter Campaign Page
聖槍十三騎士団黒円卓第一位“愛すべからざる光（メフィスト・フェレス）”。
黄金の獣と呼ばれるナチスドイツの高官だったが、あまりに有能すぎたために危険視されるようになる。
後、彼は自身が暗殺されたと偽装して闇に潜り、副首領と共に騎士団を結成。
配下の団員達を戦争の裏で暗躍させ、敵といわず味方といわず滅ぼし続け、壊し続ける。
彼の破壊工作はベルリン陥落時に頂点を迎えるが、その後は直属の部下3名と共に消息を絶ち、現在に至るも行方不明。
彼が戻ってきた時に、世界は破滅すると言われている。
圣枪十三骑士団的首领。
本来是德意志的高官，因为过于有才能而被处处提防。
之后，他以被暗杀作为掩护躲了起来，与メルクリウス一起建立了骑士团。
麾下的团员们暗中在战争中活跃，不论敌友一律歼灭破坏。
他的破坏工作在柏林沦陷时迎来顶峰，之后与直属部下3名一起失去了消息，直到现在依旧行踪不明。
称号：愛すべからざる光
黒円卓：一位
ルーン：破壊
大アルカナ：皇帝
占星術：白羊宮

A cheerful man, who arrived from the countryside by Mikado Ryuumei directive. He appeared in the middle of the Fencing Kagura ceremony after it was disturbed by Koga Rindou Suzuka, and became her loyal vassal. He has fallen in love with her and has become ready to die for her. Yet she retorted and said that his life was not only his own, and so he should not die so lightly.
His true desire is to "live". He desired to live more than anyone else.

In the beginning, he had no name. He had neither hands, nor legs, nor even eyes, nose, or ears. His true form was a teratoma in Hajun's body. He was an unneeded being, one that would be gotten rid of if found. So he tried to hide as hard as he could, covering himself in fear.
Because his host was Hajun, the power of Shinza flowed into him. He felt danger of being found, so "Sakagami Habaki" was created.
"Sakagami Habaki" was only his mental image, that he brought to the world.
【神世創生篇 主人公】
士族としてもっとも古い血統を持つ家の出だが、先祖が過去の東征で高濃度の汚染を受けたため迫害され、今では凋落しきっている。
とはいえ、本人はそんなことを一切意に介していない自由人で、無頼かつ放埓で好色な傾奇者。
要するに、ただの馬鹿スケベである。
竜胆に一目惚れし、彼女を自分のものにするため東征への参加を決意。
仲間たちからは馬鹿の一言で認識されているが、どんな苦境にも笑みを失わない天性の明るさで、彼らの中心となっていく。
「惚れたぜ、久雅の姫さん。あんたのために俺は死のう」
出身拥有最为古老的士族血统的家族。可惜这一家族因为先祖在过去的东征时受到高浓度的污染而受到迫害，现在已经家道衰弱至极了。
话虽如此，本人则是一个完全不在意这些的自由人，一个无赖、放肆而且好色的倾奇者。总而言之，就是个笨蛋色鬼罢了。
对竜胆一见钟情，为了得到她而决定参加东征。
虽然伙伴们都用“笨蛋”这一个词概括他，但他那无论面对什么困苦也能保持笑容的开朗天性，使他逐渐成了同伴们的核心。
“我爱上你了哦，龙胆公主。我愿为你赴死。”

A master of the sword from the countryside. Every single who crosses swords with him dies in a completely random way. At the earliest, within several weeks; at the longest, within several years. At first, it was something to laugh at, but time passed and an attitude completely changed. He became a feared figure. As a result, he was made a vassal by Nakanoin Reizen, who believed that this principle could be applied not only to humans but also to higher beings such as Tenma.
He participated in the Fencing Kagura ceremony and
killed honorable warriors from the Chigusa, Iwakura and Rokujou clans with a sudden attack, but in the end, was defeated by a Sakagami Habaki.

Soujirou was following the path of a demon of the sword. He deemed his fellows the ones to be cut. His sole intention and desire was to cut, cut, and cut, before he would be the only one left. This would be a testament that he is the strongest swordsman. He did not care about honour or comradery and did not want to waste any time on his path.

While time passes, Soujirou changes his ways and comes to understand certain truths. There is no point in killing in haste; one ought to be cut in due time, at due stage, otherwise fame will not spread. There is no point in killing trash; only those who are strong and worthy of challenge have a value to be cut. There are no premises not to spend time with others, even if they are to be cut. There should be an opponent, with whom one can fight; otherwise, if one to be left as the strongest swordsman, he would not be able to move forward and truly maintain his position.
Thanks to his duel with Shiori, the path to Hajun was cut open.
【威烈繚乱篇 主人公】
女性のような細面と、丁寧で物静かな態度が印象的な剣士。
だがその外見とは裏腹に、内では強者と戦って斬り捨てることにしか興味がない。
人に限らず、あらゆるものを斬れるか斬れないかでしか判断せず、目指す先は日ノ本最強の剣士。
その称号を手にするため、東征に参加する。
求道者として極まってはいるものの、ただ一つの弱点として女性の色気に哀れなほど免疫がない。
そのため、あけっぴろげな紫織が苦手である。
「ならば僕の王道も教えましょう。ひとたび抜けば、誰であろうと斬ることです」
拥有女性的瓜子脸的、给人礼貌乖巧的印象的剑士。
但是与外表相反，内心却只对与强者战斗斩杀感兴趣。
不仅是人，对所有的东西都只会判断自己能否斩开它们，目标是日之本最强的剑士。为了获得这个称号而参加东征。
尽管处于求道者的极致，但却有唯一一个弱点，那就是对女性的色气几乎无法抵抗。因此，对随心所欲的紫织感到难以相处。
「那么我也把自己的王道告诉你吧。只要拔出剑来，无论是谁都得斩」

A daughter of the Kujou House. The house serves directly to the Mikado House and may be referred to as its personal guards. It oversees the genealogy of all noble houses, identifies possible threats, and intervenes when necessary. Shiori has a younger brother who is the heir of their house.
She took part in the Fencing Kagura ceremony,
but Sakagami Habaki's dirty trick caused her to lose her will to fight
. She went to the Eastern Expedition "for domestic training".
In the first battle of the conquest, she had lost her hands. They were replaced by prostheses, created by Mikado Ryuumei with the use of puppet art.

Although Kujou House has its own battle techniques, the ones of Shiori are not pure. She employs not only the mastery of the house teaching but also her distortion: she can make her possibilities appear and switch between them at will. It makes her a particularly dangerous opponent because defeating her necessitates defeating all of her possibilities at the same time. She could be an heir of the Kujou House, but she has relinquished the right to her little brother. Her purpose for doing so is to become a bride.

She aspires to be the greatest version of herself and to excel in all areas. For that reason, she has been constantly perfecting herself. The one she lost in exchange is the strong grasp on herself. Still retaining her core, Shiori has become a vague person, who has become one who is reflected in an opponent's eyes. And she needs a husband who will reflect her in his sword as her finest self in order to become so and grip that self firmly. Shiori is looking for just this kind of reflection.
Mibu Soujirou was the one who gave her the reflection.
【威烈繚乱篇 主人公】
代々禁裏を守護する武術集団・玖錠家の長子。
とはいえ本人に流派を継ぐ気はないらしく、家督は弟に譲る予定。
それというのも、自身の技を陰が混じった邪道と認識しているためで、皇室守護の武に相応しくないと思っているから。
己の代で玖錠の陰技を完全に終わらせるため、歪みの元凶である化外を討伐するべく東征に参加する。
基本、快活で人当たりの良い姉御肌だが、戦いになれば一切の容赦がない非情な人物。
しかし平時は慎みを持った大和撫子であったりしつつ、それでいながら女性的な羞恥心が欠落しているという捉えどころのない性格。
そのため、他者から見た彼女の印象はだいたいにおいて一致しない。
「私も益荒男に恋してる。お姫様とはきっと違うんだろうけど、譲りたくないってそう思う」
世世代代守护禁宫的武术集团·玖锁家的长女。
虽然如此但是本人并没有继承流派的意思，作出了把继承权让给弟弟的决定。
另外因为自己的武技中被认为掺杂了邪道的成分，所以并不适合守护皇室。
为了使用家传的玖錠阴技来结束一切，讨伐扭曲了一切的元凶而参加了讨伐境外的东征。
基本上是待人接物态度良好的豪爽大姐头的性格，但战斗时便化身为一个毫不留情的冷酷的人物。
平时有时是一副礼仪端正的大和抚子的样子，有时又是一副对良家妇女来说欠缺羞耻心的样子的令人捉摸不透的性格。
因此她留给别人的印象总是统一不起来。
「我喜欢真正的勇者。虽然和公主不一样、但是我不会拱手相让的」

A Head of Onmyouji, serving to Mikado Ryuumei, and an arranged husband for her stepdaughter, Mikado Ryuusui. Despite this marriage being arranged, he loves her, and she loves him back. He has two shikigami, Niko and Teirei. His position as the Head of Onmyouji is only nominal, as it is Mikado Ryuumei herself who manages the work on leading onmyouji and matters like this. This role is not suited for him; he cannot even be called a proper onmyouji. He does not use proper onmyoujutsu. His techniques are unique to him and can not be properly imitated by others. Also, his nature is just not compatible with this kind of work. Therefore, he was said not to do anything. Most of the time, he brilliantly fulfills the directive by indulging in good sake. Still, sometimes he helps Mikado Ryuumei or carries out her tasks.
Yakou did not participate in the Fencing Kagura ceremony, despite being much stronger than all the participants. Instead of it, he watched Ryuusui
and appeared only after the end of the ceremony.

Yakou was a relaxed, quiet, and serene person. When Kyougetsu Sakuya saw his presence for the first time, she said that it was a hole in the space. His love for Ryuusui was rather strange. He loved her like a child, who found joy in observing ants from above. The reason for it was in his nature: he is not simply arrogant but completely distinct from other people, as he deems himself to exist on a completely different level. It was not completely without grounds, since he was a genius at things like onmyouji techniques or learning about fundamental principles of the world, such as taiji.

Still, he had no memories of when he was very young, and he could not see the principle that was determining him. It would have been impossible to paint his taichi in his own color without this. To find his core principle, to discover the truth of the law supporting the world, and to see Hajun, he went to the Eastern Expedition. In the fight with Tenma Ootake, Yakou has finally discovered that his color is death, and that his true desire is to be Yama, one who judges people after their deaths. In the same battle, after perceiving Hajun, he found out that the future he tried to open with his power would be not one with unlimited possibilities, but rather with a massacre, and he changed his ways.
He was brought into existence by Mikado Ryuusui, as an image of ideal spouse, without her even knowing it. On the other hand, his taiji was given to him by Hajun.
【咒皇百鬼夜行篇 主人公】
その咒力は史上最高。あまりに他者と隔絶した才覚は、人界に生じた穴とまで言われている稀代の陰陽師。
眉目秀麗にして頭脳明晰、非の打ち所がない貴公子だが、捻じ曲がった性格と美的感覚が総てを台無しにしている躁狂的な男である。
万事において愉快犯的な言動が目立つが、同時にどこか厭世的であり、本音のところが分からない。
東征に参加したのも、表面上は物見遊山でしかなかったようだが……
「素晴らしいな。麗しいな。退屈せぬぞ、いと愉快なり」
他的咒力史上最强。那超越其他人的才能，是甚至被称为「活着的穴」的绝代的阴阳师。
虽然是个眉清目秀而头脑聪明的、无可挑剔的贵公子，但也是个拥有足以毁灭以上一切的扭曲性格和扭曲审美的躁狂男人。
对所有事情都很显眼地抱有揶揄言行的态度，但同时又有点厌世，搞不清楚他的真意。
对参加东征这件事，表面上也是抱着游山玩水的态度……
「真是美好啊。真是美丽啊。一定不会无聊，肯定会很愉快的」

A stepdaughter of Ryuumei and the heir of the Mikado House. She has an arranged marriage with Madara Yakou. Despite the fact that the marriage is arranged, she loves and respects her fiance. From childhood, when she was adopted, she was put through rigorous training to be a proper head of the house. One of the most significant aspects of the training is onmyoujutsu.
She has the ability to look into the future in a matter of seconds, giving her an advantage in critical situations.
Ryuusui took part in the Fencing Kagura ceremony.

It is because of her future prediction that she was able to survive Mibu Soujirou's surprise strike. Only a few techniques were used by her—enemies' strikes were faster than chanting. After Sakagami Habaki arrived, she stopped fighting.
It was arranged that she would participate in the Eastern Expedition.

She is an energetic young lady with a strong will. She is more hardworking than talented. The fact that her physique appears young and lacks feminine charms is something she is bothered about. Sometimes individuals, including Habaki, refer to her as a shortie. It makes her throw a tantrum. Her main aspiration is to become worthy of her mother, Ryuumei, and spouse, Yakou.

Ryuusui regards herself as blessed. Everything is turning out the way she wants it to. This is the truth, which she had not questioned before the Eastern Expedition. All the characters in her story should be ideal. And the story should be happy for her. Those are something akin to rules.In reality, this is the form of her distortion that she is unaware of. It changes the world to her liking. Because of it, she was adopted by Ryuumei. Because of it, she has unwittingly created Madara Yakou, an exceptional man in any area. Because of it, she was able to meet with her mother even after her death.
It is she who, thanks to her distortion, revived Yakou after his defeat by Hajun.
【咒皇百鬼夜行篇 主人公】
龍明の養女であり、夜行の許婚。
神州における全術師の頭領たる御門の世継ぎだが、陰陽道に傾倒して本来の適性を歪めている。
それというのも夜行の術に憧れているからで、彼に認めてもらいたいという思いが何よりも強いから。
しかし現状、その意気込みは空回っており、望んだ結果は出ていない。
義母である龍明を崇敬してはいるのだが、この一点のみ頑なに反発している。
東征に参加するのもそうした気持ちの延長で、常に夜行の背中を追っている。
「誰がチンチクリンだ。貴様らの背がちょっと私より高いだけであろうが」
龍明的养女、夜行的未婚妻。
虽然继承了在神州内统领全术师的皇室的血脉，不过因为沉迷于阴阳道而误入歧途。
这主要是因为她羡慕着夜行的咒术，所以心里强烈地想得到他的认同。
不过目前为止，其所作的努力基本都是徒劳的，并没有达到预期的效果。
虽说对义母龍明总体上是崇敬的，但是也稍微带有些逆反心理。
参加东征也一定程度上加重了这种心情，经常是追逐着夜行的身影。
「谁是豆丁啊？你们不也就比我稍微高一点点而已嘛？」

A mighty warrior and the head of the Kyougetsu clan. This clan is famous for its members' ability to bring misfortunes. They have a big distortion and have a phenomenon of "Reverse Wind". "Reverse Wind" means that if one member of the clan brings a misfortune, the other one will die from the misfortune. He lives in a village of the Kyougetsu clan, which cannot be left easily due to the barrier of Mikado, with his sister, Kyougetsu Sakuya. Also, Keishirou has the highest known distortion level among the strong warriors.
But actually, his distortion level is lower than Sakagami Habaki's.
He was called to a Fencing Kagura ceremony as a representative of the distorted ones, but in the end
was defeated by Sakagami Habaki.

Keishirou had a rather twisted personality. He was chronically irritable. The calmer he looked on the outside, the rougher he was on the inside. Happiness was an agony for him, since it was a bewildering feeling, that was not fitting for him. It could even be called a curse. Still, he loved his sister, though he was not honest with his feelings.

While time was passing, his personality was changing and he was becoming more honest and used to his feelings. Also, there was another being that resided in him and gave him powers of distortion, Kaziklu Bey, but in the final battle with Sukuna he rejected his being and remained himself. In other words, he may be said to have broken his but only his curse at that time. Together with this, he lost his distortion and became one to achieve his goals only with his own strength.
He met his death after defending Sakuya from the Nakanoin Reizen's warriors and releasing her from the curse. As a result, he has made a crack in the World of Tengu.
【楽土血染花篇 主人公】
作中において、もっとも忌み嫌われている異能・禍憑きを宿す凶月一族の若当主。
その立場と境遇から非常に排他的で攻撃的な危険人物だが、義妹の咲耶にだけは頭が上がらない。
化外討伐のための切り札であり、使い捨ての爆弾と認識されている咲耶と一族の未来を守るため、武功を求めて東征に参加する。
知り合った経緯から覇吐とは犬猿で、互いに無視できない間柄。
「虚けが。誰に喧嘩を売っていやがる」
本作中最让人忌讳的异能・祸凭的宿主、凶月一族的年轻当主。
这样的立场与境遇让他成为了非常排他而富有攻击性的危险人物，这样的他只有在义妹咲耶面前才会抬不起头来。
为了守护被认定为讨伐化外的王牌、只能用一次的炸弹的咲耶以及一族的未来，参加东征以寻求武功。
与覇吐相识以后就一直是冤家对头，他们俩都无法无视对方。
“白痴！你是在向谁挑衅啊！”

A refined lady and a member of the Kyougetsu clan. This clan is famous for its members' ability to bring misfortunes. They have a big distortion and have a phenomenon of "Reverse Wind". "Reverse Wind" means that if one member of the clan brings a misfortune, the other one will die from the misfortune. She lives in a village which cannot be left easily due to the barrier of Mikado with her brother, Kyougetsu Keishirou. She has the highest known distortion level in the entire Shinshuu. Because of how feared she was, she spent most of her time at home, and her life would have been a lot more dull if she hadn't had her caring brother.

Actually, when Sakuya was a child, Keishirou was made to take care of her because other members of the clan feared her. He reasoned that if he needed to communicate with her frequently, it would be best to keep it casual. They've become closer over time.

Sakuya persuaded her brother to take her on the Eastern Expedition. The reason for this was not just a wish to walk freely, but also a desire to discover the source of the curse that bound the Kyougetsu clan—the garden of the bloody red roses that appear in their dreams.
She is a lovely, reserved, kind lady. Unlike her brother, she speaks her mind frankly.

Her love for her brother was very intense, but it was also a very twisted love. Sakuya was only concerned with Keishirou and thought that she herself was not necessary. She wanted to bind herself to him as much as possible. Normal acts were not enough for her—her desire was to be eaten by her brother in order to become a force, supporting him, ensuring that they would never be separated, even if they couldn't touch. This love was twisted to the point of being a curse.It has only escalated since they returned from the Eastern Expedition with triumph. She became completely attached to the Kyougetsu village and believed that she would never be able to live anywhere else. A field of bloody red roses, a place of curse, binding the clan, has become her favorite spot. The nature of her personal curse was Helga Ehrenburg, who resided inside of her. The fact that she had become pregnant with a Keishirou's child was decisive in breaking it.
In the end, she was freed from her curse by Keishirou.
【楽土血染花篇 主人公】
凶月一族の姫にして、刑士郎の義妹。
高純度の異能者であるため歩く爆弾と認識されており、常に厳重な封印と監視の下、自由のほとんどを剥奪されている。
そうした彼女を救おうと奮闘する刑士郎に妹という立場を超えた思慕を抱き、兄の力になるため東征に参加する。
か弱く儚げな外見とは裏腹に芯は強く、思ったことは何でも言うし話も長い。
好戦的で仲間意識の薄い刑士郎を制御できるのは、実質的に彼女だけ。
「満天、日や月、星やそして雪の下、誰はばかりなく兄様と歩けるように……」
凶月一族的公主，刑士郎的义妹。
因为身为高纯度的异能者而被当做自走定时炸弹般看待，在严格的封印和监视下被剥夺了自由。
对为了救助她而奋战的刑士郎抱有超过了妹妹立场的爱慕，为了成为哥哥的力量而参加东征。
和柔弱的外表相反内心很坚强，但是将自己的想法说出来时总是要说上老半天。
总是控制着好战的伙伴意识淡薄的刑士郎，实际上是其女朋友的立场。
「为了在天空、日与月、星与雪之下、无所畏惧地和哥哥大人一起漫步……」

The current head of the Mikado House. One who manages all the country's onmyouji and all sorts of other technicians. She may be said to be the most influential person in the Ashihara no Nakatsuguni. She is 80 years old yet looks like she is in her 30s due to her techniques. Ryuumei has a stepdaughter, Ryuusui.

Three hundred years ago, the future founder of Mikado House ran from Edo. Each new head of Mikado House underwent a ceremony of memory transition, so it may be said that Mikado Ryuumei existed through all three thousand years.
Ryuumei is a wise person. She rarely praises someone, being strict with herself and others.

In fact, she really hates the egocentric ways of the Shinshuu and truly abhors Hajun, whom she swore to crush. She made calculations to achieve her goal from the beginning. It was she who instigated the failed First Eastern Expedition three hundred years ago to make a battle between the western and eastern worlds more violent. It was she who continued to search for the new Hegemony, which she thought she had found in Koga Rindou Suzuka. It was she who instigated the Eastern Expedition to prepare the overthrow of Hajun.

In truth, she is Eleonore von Wittenburg, who has not lost absolute loyalty to Reinhard Heydrich. In the previous world, where Shinza was owned by Marie, she lived and reincarnated over a hundred times. Each time she lost her memories, she did not lose all her essence. It may be described as overlapping. In each life, she sought the Gold, never reaching it, no matter how hard she tried. She dedicated herself to music in one life, theater in another, and literature in the third. It was a path of ever seeking. She was more than content with it and did not go to meet Reinhard, whom she loved, since he loved all his subordinates equally and without any discrimination. Yet Hajun has killed her master and destroyed that world.

She had lived through it, but did not want to stay with the other survivors, defending the remains of the Twilight world. The reason is that it would not lead to a solution. Her link with Moment was very weak, so she was able to escape to the west to find a suitable Hegemony to overthrow Hajun. She threw away her past form to be able to live in the west.
That is how "Mikado Ryuumei" was "born".
神州に存在するあらゆる術師を統べる御門一門の現当主。
久雅家が武門の長ならば、こちらは咒の長である。
その立場と実力に相応しく、慇懃にして不敵。底知れぬ何かを漂わせた不可思議な人物で、時に総てを見透かしたような言を吐く。
記録上では八十に届こうかという年齢なのだが、その五十歳は若く見えるなど奇怪な噂が後を断たない。
「それを指して魂と言う。廃れた言葉で、消えた言葉だ。今では私くらいしか知らぬだろう」
A shikigami and a faithful servant of Madara Yakou. He is not the only one of his shikigami; the other one is Niko.
Teirei has a sober, honest, and polite personality. He is very restrained, even if he faces a person whom he deems unpleasant. It is easier to deal with him rather than with Niko.
For some reason, he does not like Kyougetsu Keishirou and Sakuya.
夜行の式神。
陰陽道の歴史において最高位の霊格を持ち、夜行にしか使役できない大英雄……らしいのだが、
本気を出すと醜いという手前勝手な彼の趣味で、童子の姿に無理矢理固定されている。
変態的な主の嗜好に困惑しながら、式として忠義を貫く苦労人。
「爾子、頼むから黙っていてくれるかい」
A shikigami and a faithful servant of Madara Yakou. She is not the only one of his shikigami; the other one is Teirei.

Niko has a cheerful personality and deems herself a maiden. She expresses her feelings openly. Like, then others praise her, and sometimes even ask for praise. It is harder to deal with her than with Teirei.
For some reason, she does not like Kyougetsu Keishirou and Sakuya.
夜行の式神。
陰陽道の歴史において最高位の霊格を持ち、夜行にしか使役できない大霊獣……らしいのだが、
本気を出すと醜いという手前勝手な彼の趣味で、仔犬の姿（ただし牛ほどの大きさ） に無理矢理固定されている。
行儀はいいが毒舌家であり、つぶらな瞳で暴言を吐く自称乙女。どうやら性別はメスらしい。
他にも人型をとることが出来るらしいが、それはなかなか見せてくれない。
獣耳の幼女だったらいいのに、と覇吐が痛い妄想をしている。
「ぐちゃぐちゃばらばらどっかーん、ですの！」
The current head of Hakanoin House, one of the six houses of generals: Koga, Nakanoin, Rokujou, Iwakura and Chigusa. These houses are handling the country's military affairs.

He is a very prominent figure because the current head of Koga House, which is the leading house out of the six, is a woman with strange ideas who is treated as an exotic beast. Actually, it may even be said that he is the most influential figure among the houses of generals. He is an ambitious, talented, cold-blooded, and competent man, who will stop at nothing to achieve his goals. His love is the current head of Koga House, Koga Rindou Suzuka, who does not reciprocate his feelings.
Reizen took Mibu Soujirou as a vassal and made him participate in a Fencing Kagura ceremony.
Also, he played an important role in the Eastern Expedition, assisting Koga Rindou Suzuka and, when she was unable to command, taking command of the army himself.

In the Eastern Expedition, in the Suwahara, Reizen met a peculiar Tenma, who he deemed as an Observant. After that, something began to crumble inside him. Changes started to appear within him. Slowly but surely, his already strong ego has begun to rise, and in the end, his mind has come to the idea that others are not needed. He became obsessed with the Hajun. He sent troops to get rid of Sakagami Habaki, Mikado Ryuusui, Mibu Soujirou and Kyougetsu Keishirou. The heads of the Iwakura, and Chigusa Houses were killed by him. In the end, Reizen has almost ceased to be himself, confusing himself with Hajun. At the end, he was able to free from the obsession thanks to Sakagami Habaki, but it was too late.
神州の武を束ねる五大竜胆紋の次席であり、現実的には武家の最大勢力である中院家の当主。
竜胆にとっては政敵だが、宗次郎にとっては主筋にあたる。
一見して飄々とした優男であるものの、その本質は冷酷かつ好戦的な野心家で、同時に狡猾さも併せ持つ危険な男。
その野望を実現するため東征戦争の裏側で暗躍し、竜胆らにとって化外とは異なる意味での脅威となる。
「つまり我らは恋敵というわけだ」

He's the leader of the Yatsukahagi that controls over Edo as his territory. Along with other Tenmas, for unknown reason they have an immense hatred towards the outsiders and will brutally kill anyone that dared to invade Edo.
"Here i swear. Extravagant exhaustion (滅尽滅相), i will not let anyone make it out alive."

In truth he's the main character of Dies Irae, Ren Fujii. After Marie universe is completed, he served as one of the Three Guardians in the 5th Heaven, along with Mercurius and Reinhard Heydrich. However, all of them save for Ren have been brutally slaughtered by Hajun. He along with several survived members of Marie universe have formed a group in the territory of Edo, which is the remnant of Suwahara City in order to prevent Hajun's law that will destroy the whole world once it has been completed.
【夜都賀波岐】
自らの理をもって、穢土全域を型に嵌めた祟神。
夜都賀波岐の主柱にして、穢土を異界化させている張本人が彼である。
このことから、化外総軍は夜刀の分身であり血肉も同様。
ゆえに彼を斃せば消滅するが、裏を返せばこの存在を消さない限り他の者らは不滅と言える。
実際、神格級の異界法則である夜刀を人間が害することは不可能で、竜胆ら東征軍にとっては絶望的な壁となる。
そして何よりも、夜刀自身が穢土の外界を激しく憎悪しているため和睦の道は有り得ない。
「滅尽滅相――誓うぞ、誰も生かして帰さない」
以自己的理确定了秽土全域的型的祟神。
既是夜都贺波岐的主柱，也是令秽土异界化的人。
从此，化外总军就成了他的分身，如同他的血肉。
因此将他杀死的话化外就能消灭，反过来不消灭他的话其他人都是不死。
事实上，人类根本不可能伤害到作为神格级的异界法则的他，对竜胆等东征军来说是绝望之壁。
而且最为重要的是，他本身就对秽土以外的地方持有强烈的憎恨，因此不可能有和睦共处的可能。
“灭尽灭相——我起誓，谁也不能从此地生还”
One of the Dai Tenma and a pillar of Yatsukahagi.
Always acting together with Morei,
having a relationship with her as both brother and lover
, he also shared a deep hatred towards the people outside Edo just like other members of Yatsukahagi
although he is an easygoing person that will create comfortable atmosphere to talk with
It could be said that he is the most dangerous person among all the Tenmas as well.
"Filfthy outsiders, in this Twilight i will grind all of you into dust and bury deep under the ground."

In truth he is one of the male character in Dies Irae as well as brother of Kei Sakurai and lover of Beatrice Kircheisen, Kai Sakurai, after the death of Marie, Mercurius and Reinhard Heydrich, he along with other survived members of Marie universe joined in the group formed by Ren in order to protect what's left of her world.
【夜都賀波岐】
穢土に君臨する大天魔、夜都賀波岐の一柱。
常に行動を共にする母禮とは双方強く想いあっている。
比較的物腰が柔らかいため話が通じるようにも思えるが、芯の部分が憎悪に狂っているのは他の化外とまったく同様。
むしろ冷徹な殺意の塊と見るのが正しい。
そのため隙が存在せず、天魔八柱の中でも上位の危険度を有する存在である。
「汚らわしい異界の者ども、この黄昏に埋もれる塵となれ」
One of the Dai Tenma and a pillar of Yatsukahagi.
Accompanying with Akuro,
unlike her brother/boyfriend
, she is very enthusiastic and keeping a direct relationship with him.
"This kind of arrogance, this feeling......As expected, you bastard is the one to inherit it."

In truth she is the fusion of a heroine and another female character in Dies Irae, as well as the sister and lover of Kai Sakurai, Kei Sakurai and Beatrice Kircheisen, after the death of Marie, Mercurius and Reinhard Heydrich, she along with other survived members of Marie universe joined in the group formed by Ren in order to protect what's left of her world.
【夜都賀波岐】
穢土に君臨する大天魔、夜都賀波岐の一柱。
常に行動を共にする悪路とは双方強く想いあっている。
悪路とは異なる激情家で、それに比例するように八柱最強格の火力を誇る。
そうしたことから、戦うにはまず前提条件として周辺被害を封じることが必須となり、武術家の類が対峙できる相手ではない。
「その驕慢、その在り方……やはり貴様は、奴の継嗣だ」
One of the Dai Tenma and a pillar of Yatsukahagi.
Oftenly called as the only rational person among the Tenmas. Even in the hostile position, she's still not someone so aggressive that will fight just because few words are exchanged.
She's the one that built up the instituitons and country in Edo.
"My own self can not remember exactly the face of other people. Ara, in the end who was it? I can not remember anymore."

In truth she is one of the female character in Dies Irae, Lisa Brenner, after the death of Marie, Mercurius and Reinhard Heydrich, she along with other survived members of Marie universe joined in the group formed by Ren in order to protect what's left of her world.
【夜都賀波岐】
穢土に君臨する大天魔、夜都賀波岐の一柱。
天魔の中で唯一の理性派と言ってもよく、その立ち居地が敵側であることは間違いないが、少なくとも問答無用の好戦性はない。
穢土の内地に独自の国めいたものを持っており、そうした体制を取っているのも彼女一人。
夜行、龍水、そして龍明に爾子・丁禮……彼ら御門の者に対し、何か因縁があるらしいが……
「何人か、見た覚えがある。ああ誰だったかしら。もう分からない」
One of the Dai Tenma and a pillar of Yatsukahagi.
Her existence is somewhat uncertain towards other people outside of Edo, because of her form is ever-changing, hence no one can fully grasp her true identity.
She is close to Momiji who can sit down and talk with, however in fact she's really unpredictable with abnormality beyond comprehension.
Due to this point, Numahime is a very dangerous opponent when it comes to unpredictability.
"How shameful and envious i am. Even i forgot the violation that happened to me too."

In truth she is one of the female character in Dies Irae, Rusalka Schwägerin, after the death of Marie, Mercurius and Reinhard Heydrich, she along with other survived members of Marie universe joined in the group formed by Ren in order to protect what's left of her world.
【夜都賀波岐】
穢土に君臨する大天魔、夜都賀波岐の一柱。
存在自体が不確かであり、それがゆえに神出鬼没。姿も千変万化するために、誰もその実体を掴めない。
紅葉に次いで話が通じる面はあるものの、同時に危ういほどの癇性を有している爆弾めいた存在で、端的に正気ではない。
予測不可能という意味では危険極まりない相手である。
「羨ましい。恥を知らないのね。だから犯されたことさえ忘れてしまえる」
One of the Dai Tenma and a pillar of Yatsukahagi. She's the acting commander of Edo in Yato's place.
Although her appearance is somewhat delicate, however her true nature is ugly and vicious, because of that no one can look at her directly.
She loves Yato but only bury this inside her heart, intead of revealing it outside.
Much like other Tenmas, she also shared a deep hatred towards the people outside of Edo.
"Unforgiveable. I will not let you pass through. From now on, none of your steps will not be allowed to be taken anymore."

In truth she is one of the main heroine in Dies Irae, Rea Himuro, after the death of Marie, Mercurius and Reinhard Heydrich, she along with other survived members of Marie universe joined in the group formed by Ren in order to protect what's left of her world. She is the one that keeping Yato alive and caring him most.
【夜都賀波岐】
穢土に君臨する大天魔、夜都賀波岐の一柱。
楚々とした振る舞いに儚げな容姿だが、本性である随神相はもっとも醜悪かつ凶悪で、誰であろうと直視できるようなものではない。
穢土の最奥から動けない夜刀に代わって、全化外を指揮する実質的な統率者。
夜刀を深く愛しているが、常に一歩引いてその気持ちを表に出さない。
どうやらそれは、彼女流の義理立てらしいが真相は不明。
「許さない。行かせない。ここから先は一歩だって、あなた達を進ませない」
One of the Dai Tenma and a pillar of Yatsukahagi.
Is a man with chaotic personality and loves to disturb others, much to the annoyance of every Tenmas.
It was due to his Apoptosis nature that opposed with Yato, Sukuna is not affected by his hatred.
"The only reason that you guys can set your foot here, was because this town is as good as dead."

In truth he is the combination of Ren's best friend and his partner in Dies Irae, Shirou Yusa and Honjou Erii, after the death of Marie, Mercurius and Reinhard Heydrich, he along with other survived members of Marie universe joined in the group formed by Ren in order to protect what's left of her world. However, he secretly works with Mikado Ryuumei in order to find a way to overthrow Hajun.
【夜都賀波岐】
穢土に君臨する大天魔、夜都賀波岐の一柱。
夜刀の太極下にあるのは確かだがそこから独立したような面もあり、もっとも奔放に動き回って場を混沌に変える。
他者を精神的に振り回して掻き乱すことに悦を覚える性のため、基本的には権謀を好んでいるが、それは戦闘力が不足しているからというわけではなく、むしろ絶対に正面切ってはいけない相手。
彼を戦場に引きずり出せば、敵味方を問わず無事ではすまない。
「もうこの邑は死んでいる。だからこそてめえらが足を踏み入れていい場所じゃねえんだよ」
One of the Dai Tenma and a pillar of Yatsukahagi.
Covered in a demonic armor that unable to see his real face, what is the truth behind his helmet is still unknown.
Much contradicted to his immense appearance, he's relatively rational, but once it comes to fighting, his violence will be revealed and can not be stopped.
"Actors acts best when they play what their roles are supposed to be——I see, so this is what the loser dogs are joking about."

In truth he is one of male character and a former comrade of Ren in Dies Irae, Machina/Michael Wittman, after the death of Marie, Mercurius and Reinhard Heydrich, he along with other survived members of Marie universe joined in the group formed by Ren in order to protect what's left of her world.
【夜都賀波岐】
穢土に君臨する大天魔、夜都賀波岐の一柱。
鬼面の甲冑に覆われたその素顔は不明であり、多くが謎に包まれている。
魁偉な容貌に反して理知的だが、それは戦いになれば手に負えない暴性の裏返しとも取れる。
宿儺とはまた違う意味で特殊な立ち位置を保っており、ことによれば夜刀と反目しているようにも見えるのだが、だからといって東征軍の味方となることは有り得ない。
「役者が良ければ芝居は至高――なるほど負け犬の戯言だ」

A lone wolf lacking in sociality. He may appear rather mature for his age, but is fast to lose his cool when complimented over his effeminate features - a trait that became somewhat of a complex for him. While normally agreeable with others, he draws a clear line between himself and the rest of his schoolmates, with the exception of a few close friends.

Unfortunately, about two months prior, a brutal fight inexplicably broke out between him and Shirou Yusa - his best friend - that left both of them hospitalized, placing Ren's already fickle reputation at school in complete jeopardy.
"If you could just get back whatever you've lost right away, wouldn't that make it worthless to begin with?"
From Dies irae's Kickstarter Campaign Page

Ren's upperclassman. Just as popular as Kasumi. But while Kasumi's popularity can be categorized as more or less conventional, Rea is idolized by those of more peculiar tastes, as - just like Ren - she normally tends to keep her distance from those around her.

She exudes an aura of aloofness, her well-ordered features of mixed German and Japanese blood rarely betraying emotion. However, despite that initial impression, she is hardly the type to be cold to others. An "eccentric weirdo" might be a more apt way to describe her, all things considered. Incidentally, her home is also a church.
"Don't you think God can be more than a little cruel sometimes? I'll make sure to throw Him a sucker punch for you next time I see Him."
From Dies irae's Kickstarter Campaign Page

The descendant of a bloodline that allied with the Obsidian Round Table during World War II. She joined the Table to fill the spot left by a member who died eleven years prior. Furthermore, as her age - contrary to the other members - does actually match her appearance, she is too young to have met the five highest-ranking members of the Table.
"I don't need the kind of miracle one could buy with tears."
From Dies irae's Kickstarter Campaign Page

segments.text: Iron Hand: Goëtz von Berlichingen is a member of the Longinus Dreizehn Orden, occupying Seat VII. An enigmatic man, with a past veiled in mystery and an equally mysterious relationship with Ren Fujii. He is also one of the Three Knights, one of three members of the Black Round Table awarded the honor of becoming an Einherjar under Reinhard Heydrich's command, serving as part of the commanding echelons of the Longinus Thirteen and an essential piece to the success of their goals.

cast.characterName: ルサルカ・シュヴェーゲリン
cast.originalCharacterName: ルサルカ・シュヴェーゲリン

segments.text: An early member of the Deutsches Ahnenerbe - Nazi Germany's institute of archaeological and occult research - and a genuine witch who had stepped into the realm of sorcery even before joining the LDO. Her youthful appearance shelters one of the most ancient souls to have sworn loyalty to the Obsidian Round Table.

Despite being cunning and crafty at her core, she is playful and flirtatious on the outside, making her a very dangerous individual to associate with. She also has a fondness for torture and is known to be extremely moody. Though essentially not a fighter, her cruelty rivals even Wilhelm's.
"Keep underestimating me and I just might gobble you up."
From Dies irae's Kickstarter Campaign Page

cast.characterName: エレオノーレ・フォン・ヴィッテンブルグ
cast.originalCharacterName: エレオノーレ・フォン・ヴィッテンブルグ

segments.text: Eleonore von Wittenburg is a member of the Longinus Dreizehn Orden, occupying Seat IX in the Black Round Table. As the most loyal and closest underling to Reinhard, she will go on to become an Einherjar and one of the Three Knights, part of the leading echelons of the Longinus Thirteen, and an essential player in the completion of the Transmutation of Gold.

Riza Brenner is the nun that is in charge of running Suwahara City's Church, inside of which she lives. She is Rea Himuro's caretaker, and acts as a motherly figure to her, and seems to have a past with Father Trifa.

Despite what her extremely kind, and even teasing and playful, disposition would suggest, she's actually a member of the Longinus Dreizehn Orden, occupying Seat XI of the Black Round Table and answering to the Demon Name of Babylon Magdalena: Great Mother.

cast.characterName: ベアトリス・ヴァルトルート・フォン・キルヒアイゼン
cast.originalCharacterName: ベアトリス・ヴァルトルート・フォン・キルヒアイゼン

segments.text: Beatrice Waltrud von Kircheisen was a former member of the Longinus Dreizehn Orden, being Kei Sakurai's predecessor in Seat V of the Black Round Table, now deceased. Despite being dead as of the beginning of Dies Irae's main story, her influence is still felt, mainly thanks to her connection to Kai and Kei Sakurai, as well as to her former commanding officer.

Ren's best friend since childhood. He is a genius skilled in all sorts of fields, but as a result, he finds life boring. As a constant thrill-seeker, he acts recklessly and even incited a brutal fight with Ren, ultimately breaking off their friendship. As a result, he vanished from school and has not been heard from since.
"Men that keep yapping on about shit at the sidelines while women do all the fighting can go to hell."
From Dies irae's Kickstarter Campaign Page

Erii Honjou is the girlfriend of Shirou Yusa. She is the daughter of a well off family, with her grandfather owning a well known hospital. While by day, she was an honors student at a prestigious school, she secretly moonlights as a rebellious hacker.
Kai Sakurai was Kei Sakurai's older brother, and a member of the Longinus Dreizehn Orden until his death. After dying, he became part of the gestalt undead known as Tubal Cain.

cast.characterName: 久雅 竜胆 鈴鹿
cast.originalCharacterName: 久雅 竜胆 鈴鹿

segments.text: The current head of Koga House, which is the main of the six generals' houses: Koga, Nakanoin, Rokujou, Iwakura, and Chigusa. These houses are in charge of the country's military affairs. As its head, Suzuka carries the honorary title of Eboshi. However, her title is mostly nominal, since she is a woman with strange ideas who is treated as an exotic beast. The most influential person among the houses of generals may be considered Nakanoin Reizen, who loves her and proposes a marriage, yet she rejects his advances. She is also known as the Demonical Princess Koga, as she is as relentless as a man. In the past, her father asked his friend Mikado Ryuumei to become a guardian for her, and so Ryuumei and Suzuka's relationships are close to those of a daughter and parent. It is thanks to Ryuumei that she got a splendid education and knowledge of the art of war.

Together with the heads of all five houses of generals, she attended a Fencing Kagura ceremony. Her house, unlike others, did not prepare an honorable warrior for the ceremony. It has been agreed that the leader of the impending Eastern Expedition will also be her spouse.

But as the ceremony continued, Shuzuka began to see it as a "dance of dead ones" and interjected. After that, Sakagami Habaki appeared, became her vassal, defeated all other honorable warriors and granted her the position of commander.
Shuzuka is a charismatic, strong-willed, and inspiring figure who may be considered a type of commander who leads an army oneself and inspirits every warrior.

Being a foreign body in the World of Tengu, she despises its egocentrical ways and infects people with her ideal: one should care and respect not only oneself, but also others and cherish their bonds. Her contribution to the Eastern Expedition has played a big part in its success.

In truth, she is a Self Destructive Factor of Sakagami Habaki. She cannot die unless he dies. Suzuka was leading him, whom she liked, to his death. Due to it, she was recognized by the Longinuslanze Testament, the testament of Reinhard Heydrich, as a new master and used it as arrows. But she became more enchanted with him over time, and her desire to be with Habaki eventually outweighed her hidden desire to kill him. It has led to fruitless efforts to end ties with her vassal.
In the end, Suzuka discarded her role as a Self Destructive Factor and chose to be with Habaki. With this, the true Hehemony was born.

The current head of the Rokujou House, which is one of the five general houses. A cunning, self-serving, and arrogant man. He is more small-minded and less talented than Nakanoin Reizen, but he is pretty tricky and sneaky. Without these qualities, he would have been assassinated in his sleep long ago.
He made a honorable warrior from his clan participate in the Fencing Kagura ceremony.
Still, the warrior died at the very beginning, along with Chigusa's and Iwakura's, due to Mibu Soujirou's surprise attack.

He went to the Eastern Expedition personally, unlike Chigusa and Iwakura. Still, his motivations were not as honorable as they appeared at first glance. Rokujou did this in order to profit while others fought and to strengthen his position.
Even though he tried to curry favor with Nakanoin Reizen in exchange for a position in the future new regime, at the meeting with a peculiar Tenma, he was betrayed and killed as a sacrifice.

actors.name: はらさわ晃綺(原沢勝広)

segments.text: The solitary survivor of a Black Ship's crew. She is an official interpreter for the negotiation mission of the United States Third Fleet under the command of Mattew Perry.
This is the official name of her mission. Its true objective is to inquire about the actions concerning the annexation of Edo.

When her ship was not far from Edo's coast, the sailors began to hear a song that was not of this world. At first, it was very faint, but as time went on, it became louder and louder. It was heard from inside the skulls of the crew members equally. The ship's course was then shifted to the chore. When it came to view, they began to leap from the ship, one by one, right into the sea. Ellie was no exception, but she was fortunate to be able to swim all the way to the chore, using all her strength. Nakanoin Reizen's warriors discovered her and took her into captivity.
Truth be told, this is all just her made-up story. In reality, she is a part of Tenma Sukuna and an Observer.

"This person had a body abnormality: a third eye. Because he was different from the normal, he was abhorred. He was sold for a dirt cheap price to reduce the number of mouths. At that time, there was a rite called "Sokushinbutsu" where a monk would depart from one's life while meditating and become a shintai as a saint mummy. And so that person was dedicated to that rite. Of course, not out of free will. He was only a very young child who could not resist. It was convenient for his buyers. If one takes a different view, his grotesque appearance was adorning, and therefore it was something to celebrate. No one noticed the truth, hidden inside.

He was dropped into a hole. A five-story shrine was built on top of it. That person was buried in the darkness with no one to contact him, with no chance to escape, with no light to touch him. There have been many days, months, and years since he was there... I don't know what sort of law (god) his buyers wished for. However, I can guess their intentions. To create a craving for the outside world. To evocate a curse of grieving to the extent of madness. To establish a hegemony with a heretic law similar to Kodoku or Inugami. And, finally, to repaint all the Twilight's creation.

It should be said that it was so foolish. Why, you ask? Because they misread the true nature of that person. Hajun (me) loved exactly that avidya (silence). The universe, that is complete only by his (mine) existence! Ah, exactly for that reason, I hate you, bastards, who never leave Hajun (me) alone! Therefore, I will find you all. I will undoubtedly crush all of nature!
'Tis is the general principle of the sixth generation, Sinza of the sixth generation!..
'Tis is all the truth of the Sixth Heaven, Hajun!"
Story of Hajun from Nakanoin Reizen.
Translated from in-game narration
